cost: 2n legal transitions; greedy scores O(n*F*(3+R)). Beam adds candidate sorting O(n*b log b) and clones O(n) configuration/path per surviving step, giving O(b*n^2) clone work. Constraints scan n for child readiness. Dense deserialization allocates rows*k with unchecked arithmetic.
description: Legal arc-standard transitions shift next buffer, Left attaches second-top under top, Right attaches top under second-top. Root is never Left dependent; Right to root waits for buffer exhaustion. Greedy maximizes valid type scores then label scores. Beam expands valid actions, sorts path scores, truncates max(width,1), labels greedily except gold/forced arcs. Constrained search returns None when beam dies. kbest deduplicates trees.

inverse: For fixed words/tags and resulting tree, compatible parser states are all weight tables/label orders whose selected transition path builds that tree. Multiple action paths can induce one tree and kbest collapses them; tree cannot recover scores or training history. Sparse table decoding reconstructs weights exactly but loses averaging accumulators.

A legal nonempty completed parse has n arcs and exactly one root attachment. No transition attaches root as dependent. Greedy label ties choose latest encountered label, not lexical order. Constraints do not guarantee existence with finite beam; nonprojective training may stop/skip. Tables do not validate all resource dimensions.
